title: Guillotine shears
subtitle: Direct-gear mechanical shears · 1/8″ and 1/4″ · 43″ to 13.8 ft · return-to-sender · cut-to-length lines
cover_line: NovoTech premium line · made in Turkey · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_kicker: NovoTech premium line · made in Turkey
about_text: The shears in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line of direct-gear motorised guillotines, built in Turkey by a maker with more than 40 years of sheet-metal machinery behind it: a 4 to 15 HP motor drives the cutting beam through a gearbox and crank — no hydraulic power pack, no flywheel clutch — for 31 to 35 clean strokes a minute, on a welded steel frame with the beam running in teflon slideways and high-carbon, high-chrome blades with two and four cutting edges.

Six series cover the sheet-metal shop: the light-type SRGM-H for 1/8″ (3 mm) and the SRGM for 1/4″ (6 mm) from 43″ to 13.8 ft, the SRGM-HFR and SRGM-FR with a return-to-sender support that brings the cut piece back to the operator, and the SRGM-HCL and SRGM-CL built into cut-to-length coil lines. Every shear is delivered with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts, blades and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.
